served.bankWhy: The sentence closes a paragraph about what the old correlation could and could not account for. Purchase here is the hold an idea has on the evidence, so losing it means losing explanatory power.

proof.quote: the correlation never pointed at lipid in particular
the lipid theory lost its purchase

passage.title: Why Anaesthesia Still Lacks an Explanation

distractorNotes: Purchase can mean something bought, but no money appears anywhere in this paragraph.
A theory is an idea and not an object, and what slipped was its hold on the evidence.
Paragraph 6 is about whether the theory still fit the evidence, not whether it was remembered; the history of the idea is not at issue.
Who supported the theory is never the subject here. What it could account for is.

answer.text: power to explain what the evidence showed
answer.line: Paragraph 6 shows the correlation never pointed at lipid. So the theory lost its hold on the evidence: its power to explain.

steps: Read the lines before the word. A lone protein reproduces the old correlation, so "the correlation never pointed at lipid in particular".
So purchase here is a hold, the grip an idea has on the evidence. Not buying, and not a literal grip.
Swap the key into the sentence: the theory lost its power to explain what the evidence showed. It fits.

choices.text: commercial backing from the companies that made the drugs
choices.note: Reads purchase as buying. No companies or money appear anywhere in the passage.

choices.text: physical grip on the membranes it described
choices.note: Purchase can mean a physical grip, but a theory holds no membrane. What slipped was its hold on the evidence.

choices.text: place in the historical record of the field
choices.note: Too far. The theory lost its standing as an explanation, not its place in the story: the passage itself tells that story at length.

choices.text: power to explain what the evidence showed
choices.note: Purchase as hold: after luciferase, the lipid theory no longer explained the evidence.

choices.text: supporters among the chemists who first proposed it
choices.note: Chemists do appear, in paragraph 5, but they built the compounds that challenged the theory. The paragraph is about what the theory explains, not who backed it.
